name: mojulo
description: Turn your agent into a 3D creative studio: a local MCP server where your agent makes 3D objects, characters, environments, interactive worlds and even playable games, kept on your machine. Play them in the browser or on your desktop, print them as STL/3MF, or open them in Godot, Unity, Unreal or Blender. No account, no API key, no external telemetry.
